overview_description.description:
CyberSec Consulting, headquartered in the UAE and serving the iMETA market, is a distinguished professional Cyber Security and Consulting services company. As a regional provider, we specialize in delivering a wide range of Cyber Security Professional Services, Remote Support, Certified Trainings, Outsourcing, Assessments, and Consulting Services. Additionally, we offer comprehensive solutions, including Managed Security Services (MSS).

Our company was founded by industry experts with extensive experience working across various sectors, including End-Users, System Integrators, Distributors, and Vendors. This expertise allows us to truly understand the regional gaps and challenges within the Cyber Security Industry. Our commitment extends beyond mere service provision; we aim to build trust and strategic relationships that enable us to deliver standardized and customized service packages that meet and exceed business expectations.

At CyberSec Consulting, we have developed a business model that boosts profitability by effectively managing risks within the ever-changing Cyber Security landscape. Our team of professional consultants possesses a wealth of knowledge in both Project Management and Cyber Security, enabling us to provide tailored Solutions and Consulting Services on market-leading Security technologies. Through these offerings, we empower our valued clients, including Customers, System Integrators, Distributors, and Vendors, to navigate the complex realm of Cyber Security with confidence.

With our focus on excellence, comprehensive services, and trusted partnerships, CyberSec Consulting is dedicated to driving success and elevating the Cyber Security standards for our clients and the industry as a whole.

about_short_description.short_description: Cyber Security Professional Services, Consulting and Training Organiation

product.name: VoIP Penetration Testing
product.description: Assessment of Voice over Internet Protocol systems to identify security vulnerabilities and protect communication networks from attacks.

product.name: Thick Client Application Security Testing
product.description: Penetration testing of thick client applications to identify vulnerabilities, business logic flaws, and security weaknesses in offline and online environments.

product.name: SAP Security Assessment
product.description: Comprehensive security evaluation of SAP systems including platform security, customization protection, and segregation of duties to identify and mitigate vulnerabilities.

product.name: SOC Security Assessment
product.description: Evaluation of Security Operations Center infrastructure to identify vulnerabilities, misconfigurations, and improve threat detection and incident response capabilities.

product.name: Configuration Review Services
product.description: Security audits of network devices, servers, and security systems to identify and remediate misconfigurations that could lead to vulnerabilities.

product.name: Cloud & Infrastructure Security Services
product.description: Comprehensive cloud security solutions including threat identification, shadow IT management, user behavior analytics, and data loss prevention to protect cloud assets.
